description: This file implements the RunC container management class and related functionalities, including container creation, execution, state retrieval, and deletion, using the runc runtime. It defines classes for container info, configuration, and the runner that interfaces with the runc executable, along with container administrator and container classes.

classes.name: Runner
classes.description: Encapsulates the interaction with the runc executable, providing methods to create, execute, delete, and query container states.

classes.name: Runner::Info
classes.description: Holds container process ID and status information, serializable from JSON.

classes.name: Runner::Config
classes.description: Represents the container configuration, including environment variables.

classes.name: Runner::Config::ProcessData
classes.description: Holds environment variables for the container process.

classes.name: RunCContainer
classes.description: Represents a container managed via runc, providing start, stop, status, and resource info methods.

methods.name: Runner::Create
methods.description: Creates a new container with specified ID and bundle path.

methods.name: Runner::Exec
methods.description: Executes a command inside the container.

methods.name: Runner::State
methods.description: Retrieves the current state of the container.

methods.name: RunCContainer::Start
methods.description: Starts the container with specified command and parameters.

methods.name: RunCContainer::Memory
methods.description: Returns memory usage info of the container.

methods.name: RunCContainer::ProcessorInfo
methods.description: Returns CPU resource info of the container.

methods.name: RunCContainer::InternalPurge
methods.description: Internal method to delete the container.
